answer_prose: Among runners initially near a four-hour target at 20 km, 2.6% who first slipped behind its budget at 25 km still broke four hours. For those first behind at 40 km, the rate was 12.4%. These checkpoints select different runners.
detail_prose: Each runner was on or slightly ahead of the target at 20 km, and then first crossed behind it at a later checkpoint.
